name: Meshy
shortDescription: Text and image to 3D assets. Free to start. Paid plans are on their site.
longDescription: Meshy turns text and images into 3D assets. The free plan includes 100 credits per month, and no credit card is needed. Paid plans start at $20 per month.
freeTierNotes: 100 credits per month. No credit card needed.
bestFor: Quick 3D assets for a game or prototype
Creators who want a $0 way to try the product
notIdealFor: Final production modeling without an artist pass
strength: The free plan includes 100 credits per month, with no credit card needed to try text-to-3D and image-to-3D.
weakness: Paid plans start at $20 per month and include 1,000 credits.
